title: Introduce RAG lifecycle playbook quickstart with background indexer and split-tool harness
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a new 'RAG lifecycle playbook' quickstart covering background indexer, split-tool retrieval/tool-caller harness, telemetry probes, and stepwise rollout guidance.
description: Context: Customers asked for an end-to-end quickstart that demonstrates practical RAG lifecycle patterns: incremental background indexing, separating retrieval from tool-calling for secure connectors, and safe rollout/rollback patterns. This PR introduces 'quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook' which includes a TypeScript starter, a Python adapter sample, a small synthetic dataset, a background indexer run via docker-compose, devcontainer for local development, embedded telemetry probes, and a short local eval harness. What this solves: developers can prototype incremental indexers (idempotent ingestion and checkpoints), observe telemetry for token/latency/cost tradeoffs, and exercise stepwise canary rollouts for index and model changes. Implementation notes: templates in TS and Python; indexer implements checkpoint file and chunking strategy; telemetry probe emits spans and minimal metrics that wire into the existing quickstarts smoke dashboard; docs page added to the docs site and automatically surfaced in quickstarts nav. Checklist: [x] add code samples and README [x] add devcontainer and docker-compose indexer [x] add quickstart docs page and nav link [x] add telemetry probes and example dashboard config [x] add smoke CI job and local smoke tests How to run locally (summary): yarn install || yarn workspace quickstarts start:dev || open http://localhost:3000/quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook || docker-compose -f docker-compose.indexer.yml up --build indexer. Security: background indexer uses local file volume and demonstrates a REDWOOD_KV_URI placeholder for secrets; README contains KMS/HSM configuration hints for Private deployments. Related work: ENG-12874 (indexer lifecycle), PM-5342 (quickstart prioritization). Commits summary: 1) scaffold quickstart and README, 2) add TS and Python templates + devcontainer, 3) add docker-compose indexer and sample dataset, 4) add telemetry probes and CI smoke job, 5) address review feedback (docs copy, KMS hints, tests). Changed areas (high-level): quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook/README.md || quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook/ts-template/index.ts || quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook/python-adapter/adapter.py || quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook/telemetry/probes.yml || quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook/sample-data/*.json || docker-compose.indexer.yml || .devcontainer/devcontainer.json || .github/workflows/quickstarts-smoke.yml || docs/site/content/quickstarts/rag-lifecycle-playbook.mdx || scripts/quickstarts/seed-index.sh Review conversation: Alexei Petrov: "Can the indexer support chunking strategies and retries?" -> Author (Maya): "Yes, added a configurable chunk_size and retry loop with idempotent checkpoint writes; see indexer/README and sample env var RAG_CHUNK_SIZE." Priya Nair: "Docs placement looks good, please add a small troubleshooting/KMS hints section." -> Author: "Added Troubleshooting > KMS notes and example env vars in the MDX page." Diego Morales: "CI was flaky on macOS runner due to optional dependency; please pin/test on linux and node16." -> Author: "Removed the optional macOS-only dep and pinned node in test matrix; re-ran CI." CI summary: quickstarts-smoke (passed after 1 rerun) || unit (passed) || lint (passed) || coverage for quickstart samples ~88%. Merge: Squash merged to main on 2026-02-23 by Maya Chen with merge commit b3f6a8e. Notes/limitations: sample dataset is synthetic and intentionally small; background indexer is for dev-pattern only and not production-ready. Follow-ups: ENG-12901 (automate hosted indexer infra), add full e2e regression tests for different chunking strategies.
